criteria.criterion: Access ClinicalTrials.gov and run search for the term "type 2 diabetes"
criteria.final_justification: The visual evidence clearly confirms the agent successfully ran the Type 2 diabetes search and reached a results list. No adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Apply required filters (Recruiting, Phase 3, United States)
criteria.final_justification: Recruiting + United States are evidenced as applied, but Phase 3 is not visibly applied in the latest state. Therefore only 2 of 3 required filters are confirmed. Keep partial credit (but not full).

criteria.criterion: Sort results by Last Update Posted (newest first)
criteria.final_justification: The evidence does not show that sorting was set to “Last Update Posted, newest first.” In fact, the only explicit sort-state view (Screenshot 11) shows Relevance selected. This is a controllable failure to confirm/apply the required sort, so the baseline 1/2 is too generous.

criteria.criterion: Report result #1 (topmost displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
criteria.final_justification: Even if a first result can be seen, the agent’s final output reports no studies/fields at all. Additionally, the required sorting wasn’t applied/confirmed, so the “first displayed after filters + newest-first sort” cannot be established. No credit.

criteria.criterion: Report result #2 (second displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
criteria.final_justification: Agent did not record/report result #2 at all, and required sort/filter state is not satisfied/confirmed. No credit.

criteria.criterion: Report result #3 (third displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
criteria.final_justification: Agent did not report result #3, and required newest-first sorting is not applied/confirmed. No credit.

criteria.criterion: Follow task constraints and stopping condition
criteria.final_justification: Constraints about not contacting/saving/submitting appear followed, but the stopping condition was not met (did not confirm all filters + newest-first sorting and did not record three results). Partial credit is appropriate.
